mentions.name: Personal P2P Mesh Network
mentions.description: Peer-to-peer mesh networking software that connects a user's own personal devices into a mesh network and also links friends' personal mesh networks together. On top of the mesh, it enables chat, media sharing, and other basic computing between friends, with data synced between devices. The underlying technology is designed to be mostly invisible so users just pair devices and start doing standard software things.
mentions.audience: Personal use among individuals and their friends; the goal is for users to pair devices and do standard software things without seeing the underlying technology.
mentions.source_excerpt: Software that connects your own personal devices to form a p2p mesh network and also connects your friends personal mesh network.

evidence.value: Software that connects your own personal devices to form a p2p mesh network and also connects your friends personal mesh network.
